svg.title: Delta and expiry ITM probability are different
svg.desc: Calculated spot Call Delta and risk-neutral probability of ending in the money under generalized Black-Scholes-Merton with K=100, r=b=0.05, sigma=0.2, T=1 year. Spot varies from 60 to 150. At spot 100 Delta is 0.636831 and expiry ITM probability is 0.559618.
svg.text: Delta and expiry ITM probability are different
Hypothetical European Call · K = 100 · r = b = 5% · volatility = 20% · T = 1 year
Q expiry ITM probability = N(d2); at S = 100: 0.5596
Fixed-parameter lognormal model. Neither curve is a real-world probability forecast.
